Name: Kitten's Shop Overhaul 1.6
Author: Neko3241
Description:
This is a smaller mod that i made for me and whoever i drag into playing some stardew valley.

It adds various items to shops such as:
[list]
[*] Pierre's General Store
[*]Marnie's Ranch
[*]Willy's Fish Shop
[*]Clint's Blacksmith
[*]Robbin's Carpentry Shop
[*]Dwarf's Shop
[*]The Adventurer's Guild
[*]Krobus's Sewer Shop.
[/list]
A majority of the items cost around 4x the price of what a normal quality one sells for, while other various items can cost quite alot of money to push it away from buying hundreds of them in a single day. 

This is my first mod upload and creation for nexus and stardew, so give feedback on what you feel would be good or such for the prices or items that are added or could be added.

Shout out to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20660]Improved Shops[/url] as i used that as a base to figure out how to edit these. 
And [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10598]Shop Overhaul Compilation[/url]/Various sub-mods that was taken for the majority of ideas on what to add

Downloads.Description:
Added Cindershard to Clint (500)
Bone Fragments to Marlon (120)
Sea (2000), Cave (1800), and River (1250) Jelly to Willy
